description: Fixture for sorting in json-browser.html. The `name` column triggers the special last-word options, so `name (last word) ▲` orders by surname: Hopper, Lovelace, Madonna, von Neumann, Smith (Ann), Smith (John), Turing, then the record with no name.
expect_name_last_word: Grace Hopper, Ada Lovelace, Madonna, John von Neumann, Ann Smith, John Smith, Alan Turing, (missing)
expect_ties: Ann Smith before John Smith — equal last words fall back to the whole name
expect_missing: the nameless record sorts last in both directions
